rationale: Motor vehicle collision resulting in vehicle damage and injuries to the policyholder; clearly within auto coverage scope.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended on Route 9 at 8:15am yesterday by a vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking. The vehicle is totaled with the trunk crushed into the back seat. Policyholder has sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Police report filed with other driver's insurance information available.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by other vehicle at approximately 35 mph, no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.police_report: filed; other driver's insurance info included

rationale: Tree falling on a parked vehicle is a classic comprehensive auto claim; damage is to the policyholder's own vehicle, not real property or a third party.
claim_summary: Policyholder Riley Kim's vehicle (parked in driveway) was struck by a falling maple tree during high winds. Hood and windshield are damaged. Comprehensive auto coverage applies; $1,000 deductible; estimated repair cost in the $2,000–$8,000 range.

case_facts.description: maple tree from own front yard fell in wind and landed on parked car
